com.vector.cfg.model.abstraction.api

Interface IModelAbstraction

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasModelObject
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    IAbstractSignalInstance, IClientServerDataMapping, ICommunicationElement, IComponent, IComponentPort, IComponentType, IConnector, IDataCommunicationElement, IDataMapping, IEvent, IExecutableEntity, IExecutionOrderConstraint, IIdentifiable, IOperationCommunicationElement, IPortInterface, ISenderReceiverDataMapping, ISignalGroupInstance, ISignalInstance, ISourceComponentPort, ITargetComponentPort, ITriggerCommunicationElement, ITriggerToSignalMapping

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IModelAbstraction
extends IHasModelObject

    IModelAbstraction is the common super interface for all model abstractions (as e.g. Object for all java classes). It defines common functionality which all model abstractions provide for generic handling of model abstractions.

      • getIdentifyingObjects

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Set<MIObject> getIdentifyingObjects()
        getIdentifyingObjects() is a bridge from the IModelAbstraction to the underlying MDF objects. For compound model abstractions e.g. a component port, not only the port, but also the component will be returned.
        Returns:
        The set of identifying MDF objects for this object.

      • getMdfObject

        @PublishedMethod
MIObject getMdfObject()
        Returns the underlying IModelObject of this wrapper instance.

        The method will never return null.

        getMdfObject() is a bridge from the IModelAbstraction to the underlying MDF object. For compound model abstractions, the main object will be returned, e.g. returns the port for a component port.

        The returned MIObject is as most specific as possible (e.g. MIIdentifiable) but AUTOSAR version independent. For more advanced features, it has to be cast to the actual used element (e.g. MIAssemblySwConnector) according to AUTOSAR. This can be determined by MDFBaseObject.mdfGetInterfaceClass().

        Specified by:
        getMdfObject in interface IHasModelObject
        Returns:
        The IModelObject of this IHasModelObject.

      • getVarianceInformationString

        @PublishedMethod
java.lang.String getVarianceInformationString()
        Computes the variance information string in case the project supports variance and the object directly has a variation point.
